content: Oettingen's WOOP/mental contrasting: cross-domain meta-analyses put mental-contrasting-alone effects around d=0.20-0.35; MCII (contrasting + implementation intentions combined) meta-analysis of 24 trials found g=0.34 (small-medium) on goal attainment. Implementation intentions alone carry the larger d=0.60-0.65 effect. WOOP's own added value beyond plain if-then planning is smaller and less certain than marketing for the technique suggests.
